title: Claude Opus 5.5 + some skills [My Workflow]
author: Groowl
selftext:
I made Neo Sigilum, a racing game where you speed up by staying in rhythm with the music (30 tracks), with Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code. Here are the skills I used, and what each one did:

* \*\*chirp-game-audio\*\*: all the music. Each track has its own electro song, written in code and rendered at every tempo, so the song can speed up with you.
* \*\*kiln-3d-assets\*\*: the 3D models: ships, a rocket, giants, monuments, machines.
* \*\*loom-textures\*\*: the materials on the roads, walls, buildings and ships.
* \*\*montage-video\*\*: editing the trailer and the short videos with HyperFrames, cut on the beat of the game's music.
* \*\*tiktok-script-writer\*\*: the scripts for the short videos.
* \*\*humanizer\*\*: the English texts in the trailer.

Two more things that aren't skills but helped a lot:

* \*\*A "human" test bot.\*\* It only sees the screen, has a reaction time and only presses left/right. It tells me which obstacles show up too late.
* \*\*A voice feedback mode.\*\* I play, talk, and press F10 on a moment. Claude gets what I said (transcribed with Whisper), a screenshot and a clip before changing anything.

Free demo in the browser: [https://groowl.itch.io/neo-sigilum-demo](https://groowl.itch.io/neo-sigilum-demo)
